CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

2. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 11
   C. 100
   D. 50

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 28
   C. 33
   D. 22

4. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

5. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 1

6. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 1

7. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/2

9. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

10. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2, 4, 6
   B. 3, 6, 9
   C. 1, 6
   D. 1, 2, 3, 6

11. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31

12. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
